senses.gloss:
__1 A house. 
__2 A refuge, shelter. 
__3 A bird. 
__4 A Śūdra. 
-Comp. 
-ज a. Born in the house; bred at home (as cows); [[Hch.]]

n. 
__1 A house, residence; as in दिवौकस् or स्वर्गौकस् a god. 
__2 An asylum, refuge. 
__3 A resting place. 
__4 Pleasure, gratification. [cf. Gr. oikos]. 
__5 Beauty or form. ग्रन्थीन्हृदय्यान्विवृणु स्वमोकः [[Bhāg. 8. 24. 53.]] 
-Comp. 
-निधनम् N. of a Sāman.
